title: Format and validate
summary: fmt checks or rewrites formatting. validate checks whether the configuration is internally valid after needed initialization.
introduction: fmt checks or rewrites formatting. validate checks whether the configuration is internally valid after needed initialization. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: fmt checks or rewrites formatting. validate checks whether the configuration is internally valid after needed initialization.
The commands report formatting or configuration problems. They do not apply the planned resources.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Make an indentation change and see what fmt -check reports.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.text: Validation does not prove the planned infrastructure is appropriate or affordable.
